text:
pagerduty-bot: [PAGED] PROD - surge of 5xx (edge -> gateway) observed from 10:12:07 UTC. Threshold breached: 8% 5xx across edge pool for 60s. Impact: user requests failing intermittently. Pager: @sre-rotation :rotating_light:

emma: acked. I'm on it. Looking at top-level metrics and recent deploys. Any recent config rollouts to loadbalancer or envoy routes?

jon: I rolled out a small route-weight tweak to shift traffic for a canary around 09:58 UTC (automated rollout via platform). Rolling back now to verify. Seeing lots of upstream 502/504 in envoy logs: `upstream reset`, `no healthy upstream`.

marina: checking control plane events — no host-level machine failures. Envoy admin shows clusters healthy but endpoints flapping. Dumping cluster stats: 
```
# curl -sS http://localhost:9901/clusters | head -n 40
cluster: gateway_pool internal_upstream: 5/10 hosts, cx_active: 120, cx_connect_fail: 15, rq_5xx: 134
```

emma: that matches metrics. My hypothesis: route weights moved traffic to a shard with degraded upstreams triggering retries and exhausting connections -> cascading 5xx. Two mitigations to try quickly: 1) temporarily disable client-side retries for affected route in envoy (prevent storm of retries), 2) reduce max connections/circuit breaker thresholds so traffic is shed earlier instead of queueing.

rachel: customer-impact check — Support is getting spike in tickets from EU region complaining of intermittent errors. Notified account teams for high-usage customers.

jon: applying a targeted Envoy config patch to the edge route to remove `retry_policy` and set `per_try_timeout`=1500ms. Patch via xDS control plane now (pushing minimal change). Paste of the patch I'm sending via control plane: 
```
route_configuration:
  name: edge_routes
  routes:
  - match: /api/
    route:
      cluster: gateway_pool
      retry_policy: null
      per_try_timeout: 1500ms
      max_grpc_timeout: 1500ms
```

deploy-bot: started rollout of config patch edge_routes @ 10:21:32 UTC. Change-id: cfg-202803-3

emma: monitoring. Traffic is rebalancing, 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 3.5% in last 2 mins. Still some spikes.

marina: also seeing connection churn on 10.0.45.x upstream hosts. I'm marking two hosts as unhealthy in the pool to stop routing there (manual remove).

jon: I put a temporary cap on max connections for gateway_pool to 60 and lowered max_pending_requests to 100 to avoid head-of-line blocking. Pushing via admin: 
```
# envoy admin
POST /clusters/reconfigure
payload: {"name":"gateway_pool","max_connections":60,"max_pending_requests":100}
```

emma: good. After both changes, 5xx dropped to 1.2% and latency normalized for most routes. Alert rate back below threshold but we should keep monitoring for 30m.

rachel: capturing customer impact summary: ~6% of requests in EU between 10:12-10:24 had 5xx; top error codes 502, 503; affected customers: alice-enterprise, beta-app. Support already sent initial message and is offering retry guidance.

sre-rotation: taking over full incident for postmortem and followups. Action items for next hour: 1) keep config patch (no retries) for 30m, 2) run healthcheck sweep on gateway_pool endpoints, 3) correlate prior host CPU/memory around 09:50-10:10 to see root cause, 4) prepare rollback plan for platform route-weight automation if that triggered it.

jon: note — platform's gradual-shift policy bumped weight to shard-b at 09:58, but control-plane did not wait for steady-state (a bug in traffic-check). Opening a ticket.

marina: I've quarantined two unstable hosts and scheduled immediate instance reprovision. Healthcheck results show high connection resets on those instances.

emma: ok to close this page? current 5xx < 0.5% for last 3 mins and no new tickets after support outreach. I'd like a short oncall handoff doc and a postmortem ticket.

sre-rotation: leaving note for next shift: monitoring link (https://console.redwood/alerts/2281459000), runbook steps we took, config ids (cfg-202803-3), hosts quarantined (10.0.45.12, 10.0.45.13). Opening incident: INC-2028-153.

rachel: tagging Customer Success for follow-up emails. Also recommend rate-limiting customers with aggressive retry clients until root cause fixed.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for cfg-202803-3 at 10:24:02 UTC. No errors in control-plane push.

emma: thanks all. Postmortem owner: @jon. Rachel will lead customer comms. Handing off to @sre-rotation for monitoring and next steps. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged and resolved for now. If 5xx > 2% for 5m, will re-page the rotation.
